title: Oʼodham language
description: Uto-Aztecan language spoken in Mexico and US
extract: Oʼodham: is a Uto-Aztecan language of southern Arizona and northern Sonora, Mexico, where the Tohono Oʼodham and Akimel Oʼodham reside. In 2000, there were estimated to be approximately 9,750 speakers in the United States and Mexico combined, although there may be more due to underreporting.
